traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text:
The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth)
checks to hide in cavernous and rocky underground terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cave giant makes two greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one
target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target.
Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must
succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
